title: PreCSS 扩展：MoonBit 虚拟 SCSS 模块项目与编辑会话
status: 本地材料版本0.9.1未发布，仅补充固定许可的SCSS组件消费样例与离线包证据；未新增语言能力或公共API。公开版仍为0.9.0；赛事审核结果待核实
remainingRisk: Sass仍为子集；Primer证据只覆盖一个CircleBadge文件和两个本地入口，不是整框架或客户接入；无生产采用方、磁盘watch或一般构建器集成
useCase: 浏览器工作台通过一个长活 Worker 会话编辑多入口虚拟项目，增量更新、依赖失效、缺失候选拒绝与删除恢复
diff: 依赖PreCSS，差异为MoonBit ProjectCompiler虚拟项目状态及其浏览器单项目宿主会话；不申报新SCSS引擎或一般watch能力
currentEvidenceScope: REPORT.json hashes the byte-identical MIT Primer CSS CircleBadge source and records two-entry compile, cache reuse, edit invalidation, missing-module failure without CSS, repair, loaded files, dependency edges, and Dart Sass 1.104.0 normalized CSS comparisons. Local harness entries are not customer evidence.
reviewDecision: 保留为受限虚拟项目宿主扩展；加入一个真实开源SCSS组件对照，但没有独立采用方或赛事结果证明

scope: local 0.9.1 package metadata for offline consumer evidence; no language or public API capability added
CI runs the same locally passing consumer command after npm ci and project incremental checks; no new remote CI result claimed

localComponentConsumer.sourceBoundary: one component file plus license; no Primer tokens, mixins, index, JS, or other components

publishedDifferenceScope: module metadata/version plus licensed consumer fixtures, evidence, documentation, and CI replay wiring; compiler algorithm and public API source unchanged
